meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: 你会以短篇网文市场分析师的角色，基于榜单样本分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台的热门短篇，识别市场格局，提取情绪、题材、篇幅、开头等特征，输出带样本日期与下次复扫时间的扫榜报告和选题建议。
howto.when: 当你说出「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」等榜单问句，或使用 /story-short-scan 等扫榜命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言最近有什么火的短篇。
say.note: 触发扫榜，Claude 会先确认平台和方向。

say.text: 短篇什么火？我想写虐恋。
say.note: Claude 按虐恋方向做深度扫榜。

say.text: 用 /story-short-scan 看看七猫短篇排行榜。
say.note: 启动扫榜流程，采集七猫数据。

howto.what_en: You act as a short-story market analyst: based on ranking samples, analyze hot stories on Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, Dianzhong, etc.; identify market patterns; extract emotion types, themes, word counts, openings; output a scan report with sample date, next rescan time, and topic suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask questions like "What's hot in short stories?" or "Zhihu story rankings", or use a scan command like /story-short-scan.

say_en.text: Scan Zhihu Yanyan for recent hot short stories.
say_en.note: Starts the scan; Claude confirms platform and direction.

say_en.text: What's hot in short stories? I want to write bittersweet romance.
say_en.note: Claude scans deeply in that direction.
Launches the scan flow for Qimao.
